limitations: No product/source changes, no game integration, no tests/build run.
Generated backings require runtime clue text and circuit overlay; no generated puzzle answers.
Built-in imagegen only; no paid provider/SDK/CLI calls.

All33 new assets are dedicated individual PNGs (20 transparent object cutouts, 13 opaque wide closeups); two reused scene PNGs opaque. Five original generated variants retained as evidence, total40 PNGs in owned directory.

Blank circuit backing does not display 3x3 tiles/connected network yet; FUSE_INSTALLED/CIRCUIT_READY static backings intentionally near-identical. Source renderer's actual state/lines must be overlaid and coordinates recalibrated before integration.
Generated broad CRT screen shapes are decorative empty backing; controlled runtime labels/content still required. Chinese maintenance/optional-story text is not baked into pixels.
Some cutouts retain semi-transparent warm/shadow halos; true alpha present, not verified shadowless. A few edits drift1pixel in dimensions; alignment/scaling required.
Full room2 backgrounds include existing devices; r2_light_overlay_on.png is FULL scene reuse, not transparent light-overlay replacement.
No formal game QA, build or API runs justified for concept-art-only files; no claims of drop-in readiness.
alphaValidation: System.Drawing.Bitmap GetPixel sampled every16 pixels to establish transparent pixels, and full-image visual review. This is not an exhaustive alpha-cleanliness guarantee.

controlledOverlayPolicy.circuit: 3x3 tiles and every live wire/connection/completion glow derive from public server state at runtime; generated backplate intentionally blank. CIRCUIT_READY fuse installed but master stays off.
controlledOverlayPolicy.monitor: Generated shapes are only blank visual backing; typed USER/PASS, actual archive and public labels must come from controlled runtime overlay; no answer content drawn.
controlledOverlayPolicy.maintenance: USER使用实验室的完整编号；PASS采用实验开始时间，格式为HHMM，不包含冒号。
controlledOverlayPolicy.service_label: 箱背的维护签上留着几代人的日期和签字，末行写着：“交接前，请检查设备并关闭出口。”
